newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia C.Bank drops Eurobond maturity limit plans.
newsitem.headline: Russia C.Bank drops Eurobond maturity limit plans.

text.p: The Russian Central Bank has dropped the idea of granting limited licences to convert hard currency proceeds from regional Eurobond issues, a senior Central Bank official said on Thursday.
"We've dropped the idea," First Deputy Chairman Alexander Khandruyev told Reuters. "Now we grant licences for as long as a bond runs."
Eurobond syndicate managers said in London recently the Central Bank was limiting the term of licences to three years, effectively cutting Russian regional Eurobond maturities to this period.
Russia's first municipal Eurobond, launched last week by the City of Moscow, ran for only three years. But on Thursday St Petersburg announced it would launch a $300 million five-year Eurobond.
